overall_notes: This paper focuses on NLG for educational dialogue generation, specifically generating remediation responses to math mistakes. The evaluation is primarily human-based with detailed pairwise comparisons. No traditional automatic metrics were used for NLG evaluation - only lexical analysis for understanding model behaviors.
